title: When the Garden Sings
author: Oscar Zhou
blurb: Quentin Iversen, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
